Isenberg abstract quote verbatim; SRI-4 is the registered primary; NCT02908100 results posted 2020-07-07 (year 2020 right). Patient_trials verified (registry 2020-12-17, 2023-07-21; quotes in abstracts). Wallace 2022 also states the comparison for the class.

Liver AESI quote verbatim in Wallace full text. No member approved, so no FDA review package; no public GLP tox found. epub_year/print_year 2022/2023 describe the patient source while the entry year is 2017: cosmetic.
Herman 2018 (PMID 29484638, epub 2018-03-23) abstract: quote verbatim. Opening untested entry for an HV-fitted PK/PD model; HV data fitted the model so is not its test. Tier 1, year 2018 correct.

Isenberg 2021 full text (Wiley via fc.py, output truncated mid-quote): 'reductions in pBTK levels consistent with those predic[ted]'; ref 11 is Herman 2018. Prediction predates SLE results, so prospective: same, not retro. pBTK direct.
Herman 2018 abstract quote verbatim; model stated a regimen target (high BTK inhibition over dosing interval). No margin from the model itself; untested 2018 opening correct.

Isenberg 2021: 'dosing regimens of fenebrutinib were selected based on a previously generated PK/PD model of BTK inhibition (ref 11 = Herman 2018)'; troughs gave predicted pBTK reduction. Target reached, so same; efficacy failure belongs to efficacy. Prospective.

missing: No new model track found. Additional engagement data, status-neutral: elsubrutinib arm biomarkers in the SLEek study (Lupus Sci Med 2026, doi 10.1136/lupus-2026-002162, epub 2026-10-29; abstract not available) set against ABBV-105 NZB/W data (Goess 2018); same nzbw-lupus-mouse track.
Healthy-volunteer occupancy for evobrutinib (Becker 2019, doi 10.1111/cts.12713) is missing as the earliest engagement/dose comparison; see engagement 5 and dose 2.

Wallace 2022 (doi 10.1002/acr2.11511) states the mouse-to-patient efficacy comparison itself ('Several studies have demonstrated that BTK inhibitors are effective in murine models of SLE; this effectiveness, however, has not translated'): could be cited as a comparison_stated:true efficacy entry; status unchanged.
rule_questions: Is a PK/PD occupancy-efficacy model fitted in the same NZB/W mice a separate track from the efficacy readouts in those mice? I treated it as the same system (one model_id).

The engagement track pools a direct readout (BTK occupancy: matched) and a downstream readout (autoantibodies: contradicted, evobrutinib). Under 'contra beats same' the cell shows contra although target engagement held; should engagement be scored per readout_tier?

The 80% occupancy target was published (Haselmayer, April 2019) after the member SLE trials started (Jan 2017) but before any readout. Does the 'stated before the trial' requirement apply to dose targets as well as to margins?

Fenebrutinib SLE regimen: the HV PK/PD model (fenebrutinib-hv-pkpd) stated the regimen, but the BTK-inhibition level it aimed at came from NZB/W mice (Isenberg 2021 dose rationale, ref 16). Does the dose target score on both the HV-model and mouse-btk-occupancy-pkpd tracks, or only one?
